span.term: COVID-19 disrupted teaching and research activity and diverted attention to building online/hybrid learning environments, which is why no conceptual change study appears in the 2020-2021 window
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Studies that found a conception and no change were excluded, so the corpus is selected on the outcome the review reports.
span.note: what this limits: any characterisation here of what conceptual-change research has found: studies that merely identified students' alternative beliefs, without testing whether those beliefs were changed by a specific intervention, were excluded from the review
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The review's own verdict is that one framework across the literature determined how the construct was measured.
span.note: what this limits: any figure or trend reported from this literature: the review states nearly all the studies observed conceptual change from a cognitive-only framework, which led to examining conceptual change quantitatively
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The corpus is what a keyword search returned, narrowed by hand from hundreds to fifty.
span.note: what this limits: the review's claim to be exhaustive: hundreds of documents were discovered by the search and only 50 matched the authors' criteria
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The selection required an intervention aimed at conceptions, which fixes the kind of study that can appear.
span.note: what this limits: the range of designs represented here: the two primary selection criteria were that a study be in science education and use certain treatments to measure or improve students' conceptions
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: conceptual change - AS A COGNITIVE VARIABLE WITH A MEASUREMENT MENU: what the reviewed studies actually recorded was a profile of conception or understanding, remediation of misconception, or learning gains, nearly always from a pre- and post-test
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: misconception - AS A CATEGORY ERROR: on the classical model a misconception is a concept assigned to the wrong ontological category, so change means altering what kind of thing the student takes the concept to be - a definition that makes some disagreements invisible
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the same object under several names - students arrive with prior ideas called alternative conceptions here, alternative beliefs in the exclusion rule, and misconceptions in the classical model, with no statement anywhere that the three are the same thing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: conceptual change - THE ONTOLOGICAL READING (Chi, Slotta & De Leeuw 1994): change in what KIND OF THING the student takes the concept to be. On this reading a misconception is a concept filed under the wrong ontological category, so the change is a recategorisation.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: conceptual change - THE AFFECTIVE READING (Pintrich et al. 1993): motivation, interest and self-efficacy are not conditions FOR the change but factors IN it. The paper calls this `another version`, i.e. a rival account of the same term.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: conceptual change - THE MULTIDIMENSIONAL READING (Tyson et al. 1997): epistemological (classical), ontological AND affective aspects together. This one is defined by UNION of the other readings, which is why it cannot be scored on the same instrument as any of them.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: conceptual change - THE EXTENSION WIDENED OVER TIME, and the paper says so as its own finding: from cognitive-only to including student traits. A study from before the shift and one from after are not measuring the same construct, which is what makes the review's 50-study pooling a definitional question and not only a methodological one.

span.label: Across the 50 reviewed studies, physics was the science domain most often targeted by conceptual change research, ahead of the other science domains.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Newtonian mechanics was the single most frequently examined physics topic in the reviewed conceptual change studies.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Undergraduate students from a range of majors, not only science education students, were the most common participants in the reviewed studies.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Quasi-experimental designs comparing treatments between groups dominated the reviewed conceptual change research.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Method was dominated by pre- and post-testing of small groups with quantitatively analysed data.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Nearly all reviewed studies framed conceptual change from a cognitive-only perspective, which in turn pushed them to measure conceptual change quantitatively - the review's main theoretical criticism of the field.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Although the search window ran to 2021, the review found no conceptual change study published during the 2020-2021 pandemic period.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Only five of the fifty reviewed studies examined the conceptual change of pre-service teachers or in-service teachers, leaving that population largely unstudied.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Affective, metacognitive and other non-cognitive variables were assessed almost entirely through refutation texts, questionnaires or interviews rather than through instructional interventions designed around them.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
